name: Beta throwaway made
notes: Beta runs to level 30 through Oct 21. Do not spend Skyrinis, Sorinis, or Malavus. Those names wait for reservation.

name: Reserve Skyrinis Starhollow
notes: Slot 1 of 3. Oct 27 through Nov 3. Skyborne Druid, Feral.

name: Reserve Sorinis Starhollow
notes: Slot 2 of 3. Night Elf Druid, Balance.

name: Reserve Malavus Blackwell
notes: Slot 3 of 3. Human Warlock, Affliction.

name: First Mate Band
notes: ilvl 22 strength ring from Mr. Smite. Half of the Partners in Crime set. Bank it. Ephai can use the same ring.

name: Rockslicer
notes: Unique two-hand axe from Rhahk'Zor. Mines Copper, Tin, Silver, or Iron without Mining. 30 charges, then the mining effect dies and the weapon stays. Farm on Malavus, Sorinis, or Taloninis. Same run as First Mate Band and Lookie's Spyglass.

name: Partners in Crime 2-set
notes: First Mate Band plus Band of the Better Half. Angry proc.

name: Embrace of the Viper
notes: Five Fang pieces. Hidden 5-piece turns cat form into a snake. Race-colored. Slither prowls.

name: Hunter family pet skills
notes: Keep the family uniques. 10% attack power and 100% crit. Stable a toolbox.

name: Coldflame Saber
notes: Baron Silverlaine, via Scroll of the Saber. +7 Intellect, +32 spell power, +98 Fire melee against Frozen. Fingers of Frost does not freeze for the proc.

name: Band of the Better Half
notes: Other half of the Deadmines 2-set. Source still unknown. Ephai can use it too.

name: Library books (10 / 20)
notes: Book turn-ins at 10 and 20: Scholarly Pendant, Erudite Amulet, Field Researcher Loop.

name: Malignant Root
notes: Turn in at Rethiel. Mid-level flavor unless level 60 stats confirm it.

name: Barrens rare 2-piece
notes: Humar, Swiftmane, and Takk. +5% movement in the Barrens and Stonetalon.

name: Hyjal craftable tier
notes: Profession recipes. Malleable Essence of Nature for the buy and the craft.

name: Reins of the Pack Kodo
notes: Fill Waylaid Crates and turn them in to Marcy Baker. Huey Sunnydale sells the mount for 6000 Merchant's Favor.

name: Scroll of the Saber and mage imbues
notes: Comprehension and Study books, then the scroll. Ice Knife freezes from a dagger. Imbue Spark resets Fire Blast on a melee hit. This is not a new class.

name: Windcharged Leaf
notes: Shapeshift mana cost down 40. Likely Windshaper only. Confirm in beta before anyone farms it.

name: Lookie's Spyglass
notes: Cookie drop. A zoom toy, not a combat trinket. Grab it with the First Mate Band.

name: Prairie Chicken
notes: Saldean feed, then /chicken until the chicken turns green. Egg pet. First Alliance character.

name: Savory Whimsyfin Delight
notes: Cooking 85. One Whimsyfin plus Mild Spices makes two. One hour as an ogre or a murloc.

name: Musical Gustjumper
notes: Serenade the frogs on the waterfall rock.

name: Minimule
notes: ACA vendor. 1500 Merchant's Favor. Packmule Treat.

name: Black Market
notes: Pets, TCG, tier 0, mounts. A gold sink, not a gear plan.

name: Goblin Gumbo Kettle
notes: TCG toy, not a cooking recipe. Watch Madam Swyndle on the Black Market. 5-minute poison belch, no nutrition.

name: Zergling
notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.

name: Panda Cub
notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.

name: Mini-Diablo
notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.

name: Pachimari
notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.

name: Lordaeron tabard
notes: Pack tabard.

name: Shen'dorei tabard
notes: Pack tabard.
